claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens and Nikon branding, but the exact model number (D3400) is not readable in the provided angles.
Lens is visible with markings and a DX label, but the specific 70-300mm part number/range is not fully readable from the witness report.

claims.claim: Working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No proof of operation is shown (no shutter test, autofocus test, or screen/EVF check).
No shutter count readout is shown or referenced in the witness photos.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Lens condition details like fungus/haze/scratches are not shown clearly in the witness report; only general exterior wear/scuffing is mentioned.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired
claims.evidence: Accessories and repair history are not shown in the witness photos.

risks.risk: Exact camera model may not be D3400 (could be another Nikon DSLR), which changes value and compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera model name/number on the body (e.g., D3400 marking) and/or the EXIF/system info screen showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unidentified Nikon DSLR body (worst-case generic DSLR value) until the exact model is confirmed.

risks.risk: Lens may not be the claimed 70-300mm; could be a different Nikon lens or different version, affecting resale value.
risks.proof: A close, readable shot of the lens front/rear text showing the exact model/part number and focal length (e.g., '70-300mm' and lens type).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unspecified Nikon zoom lens (worst-case) until the exact lens model/range is confirmed.

risks.risk: Seller’s 'working perfectly' claim may be false (shutter, autofocus, sensor, or buttons may have faults).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing: powering on, live view, autofocus lock on a nearby object, and a short shutter test (multiple shots) with images saved and displayed.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'untested/possibly faulty' or 'needs servicing' until operation is demonstrated.

risks.risk: Lens internal issues (haze, fungus, oil on blades, or scratches) may exist even if exterior looks fine.
risks.proof: A bright flashlight inspection clip through the front and rear elements at angles (and a macro shot of the glass) plus a test photo showing contrast/flare behavior.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'lens condition unknown' (worst-case) until internal glass condition is verified.

risks.risk: Exterior wear/scuffing is visible; could indicate heavier use and possible cosmetic damage to ports/hinges.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the screen/eyepiece area, hot shoe, ports (USB/HDMI), and lens mount contact points.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for worn cosmetic condition until those areas are checked.

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete or not original (battery/charger/memory card/hood/strap), reducing practical value.
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with labels (battery model, charger model, lens hood, strap, manuals, memory card).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing or non-original accessories (worst-case) until the full bundle is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera model marking (confirm D3400) and/or a screen showing the exact model in the menu.
Close readable shots of the lens focal length and exact lens model/part number (confirm 70-300mm).
Power-on + live view clip, autofocus test (lock on and refocus), and a short shutter test showing saved images.
Lens glass inspection clip with flashlight from multiple angles (front and rear elements) to rule out fungus/haze/scratches.
Photos of included accessories laid out (battery/charger labels, lens hood, strap, memory card, manuals/box if present).
A shutter count readout screenshot (or in-camera/external tool output) showing the number.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Nikon DSLR with a zoom lens and some exterior wear, but the exact D3400 model, the 70-300mm lens specification, and working condition/shutter count are not verifiable from the provided report. Missing operational and identification proof prevents confident pricing.
